verified_facts: EA data is supplied in OSGB36 British National Grid
EA elevations are recorded above Ordnance Datum Newlyn
EA composite uses the current transformation model stated in its metadata guidance
timestamped and point-cloud data require survey-specific geoid metadata
surveys after 26 August 2016 use OSGM15 according to EA guidance
OSTN15 links GNSS positions with OSGB36 National Grid
OSGM15 links GNSS heights with mean-sea-level based height systems
horizontal transformation error and vertical terrain-surface error are separate uncertainty components
quality_effect: Binds candidate elevation to explicit CRS/datum/geoid context and separates geodetic transformation uncertainty from terrain-surface uncertainty.
